home.title: Welcome
home.heroTitle: Excellence in sensory evaluation and consumer science
home.paragraph1: We are an institute offering a wide range of services focused on sensory evaluation and consumer science in the food industry and consumer products.
home.paragraph2: INESA is recognized for its expertise and contribution to the field through research, publications, international courses, and consulting for the business sector.
home.paragraph3: Contact INESA to explore how our services can help your company perfect your product, bringing improvements for your customers.
home.paragraph4: We invite you to discover our experience and skills in problem-solving using sensory analysis.
home.finalCtaText: Our team provides personalized and professional support to solve sensory challenges in your business.
